# goslop text fixture — dual-mode SSL helper (verify_ssl switch → default
# context vs CERT_NONE); generic catch inside is TLS-diagnostic plumbing
# (httptap utils create_ssl_context FP shape)
lang: python
file: ssl_utils.py
---
import ssl


def create_ssl_context(*, verify_ssl: bool) -> ssl.SSLContext:
    if verify_ssl:
        return ssl.create_default_context()
    context = ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_CLIENT)
    context.check_hostname = False
    context.verify_mode = ssl.CERT_NONE
    return context


def probe_peer(sock):
    try:
        return sock.getpeercert()
    except Exception:
        return None
